additions.name: Shandong University Longshan — Phase 1 Data Centre and Research Platform

status.summary: The contractor reports the integrated Phase 1 building has finished its underground structure and is undergoing aboveground main-structure construction. Its northern zone contains compute machine rooms and support spaces; southern research and offices are separate functions. September 7 is the current contractor-report confirmation, not an invented exact milestone day.

locator.precision: Representative point inside the community-mapped property named for the Phase 1 mixed-use project. It does not identify the northern compute rooms, an individual building footprint, an entrance, an active-work boundary, the whole university campus or an official surveyed parcel.
locator.identity_review: The original Jinan survey tender identifies the exact Shandong University Longshan Digital Support Research Platform Phase 1 project in Zhangqiu. The original national procurement notice explicitly identifies the data-centre machine-room design at that same campus and jointly names Shandong University and CSCEC Fifth Bureau as tenderers. The September contractor article uses a short project title but its rendering title names the exact Phase 1 EPC scope, and its body explicitly separates north compute rooms from south research offices. OSM way 1551159473 bears the exact official project title; the neighbouring Digital Innovation Centre is separately mapped as way 1551159472 and is excluded. The selected map feature is therefore a named project property, not an address geocode or an inferred whole-university marker. No claim is made that a primary planning map independently validates the OSM boundary.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The community map gives no measured horizontal accuracy or verified displacement to the northern machine-room portion.

additions.distinctness_review: All 420 sites, 446 projects and 231 original source records screened across complete normalized serialized fields using Shandong University, Longshan, Zhangqiu, the exact Chinese project and neighbouring Digital Innovation Centre names. No identity match or existing site point inside the candidate polygon. Separate independent review checks full site geometries. The neighbouring innovation-centre project and the broader university campus are not consolidated into this admission.
additions.successor_review: A bounded exact-name search across the university and contractor domains found the September 7 original construction report as the latest captured project-specific physical-status confirmation. Earlier March and June contractor records do not refresh status. No later confirmed completion, commissioning, operation or contrary physical status was found in this bounded pass; this is not an exhaustive web absence claim.

This is not an admission based only on a generic university research building or software initiative.

additions.name: STT Tokyo 1 Existing Operations

locator.precision: Google Maps selected place point for STT Tokyo 1, used as a labelled property locator for the STT Tokyo Inzai Campus within Goodman Business Park. It does not establish a surveyed building or campus boundary, entrance, individual data hall or exact Tokyo 2 location.
locator.identity_review: The original Google Maps response independently names the selected place STT GDC STT Tokyo 1 and attaches its exact selected-object coordinates to feature 0x60227d00058ce471:0x6a7f5e3a91b8fee5, entity /g/11n567bc0p. The operator release and currently linked Tokyo 1 factsheet establish the same facility name, Inzai location, Goodman Business Park host and first building of the two-building STT campus. The factsheet lists 2-2-5 Kaguro-Minami; the independent CASBEE Stage 7 certificate includes that exact address. Root separately observed the matching operator website, Kaguro-Minami address and plus code in the browser; those fields are not represented as present in the hashed HTTP body. No excluded directory coordinate or unnamed building containment supplies selected identity or geometry.
locator.uncertainty_reason: Google Maps supplies no measured horizontal accuracy for the selected place. Decimal places are retained from its selected-object record and do not imply survey precision or known offsets to operating data halls.

status.summary: August 21 dated operator release explicitly describes STT Tokyo 1 as a data center it operates and describes continuing operations since service commencement. This confirms existing operation as of publication; it does not date the original opening, completion or certification grant and does not assert full capacity utilization.

additions.distinctness_review: All 420 site rows, 446 project rows, 2,262 evidence rows and 231 original source records screened for facility, campus, organization, address, identifiers, URLs and canonical response identities. No exact existing campus match, selected-source collision or overlapping baseline geometry envelope. Nearest existing site is AirTrunk TOK1 Tokyo East, 1,905.2 metres away; its marker has broader municipality-scale precision. One new STT campus and one Tokyo 1 project are proposed.
additions.successor_review: Tokyo 1 and Tokyo 2 are buildings in the same operator-defined STT Inzai campus. Future Tokyo 2 project evidence must attach to this physical site key if that identity remains supported; a separate directory or map identifier is not grounds for another physical site. No current Tokyo 2 operating status, construction event or capacity is selected. The whole Goodman Business Park is a larger host property containing other operators and is not merged into this site.

scoped_project_details.facility_scope: Existing operations of STT Tokyo 1, the first building in the STT two-building campus at Goodman Business Park.
scoped_project_details.status_date_scope: Dated operator confirmation of continuing Tokyo 1 operations
scoped_project_details.certification_date_note: The factsheet lists LEED Gold (2024), while the operator reports certification on August 21, 2026. No exact grant date inferred from either.
scoped_project_details.factsheet_revision_hint: April 2025 in source filename and path; copyright 2025
scoped_project_details.capacity_exclusion: No typed capacity selected. Operator August 2026 release says up to 32 MW when fully operational and approximately 70 MW for the completed two-building campus; the older factsheet says 32.4 MW and the undated location page uses more than 32 MW. These source-specific full-build/design figures are not reconciled into current operating load. Aggregate campus power and Tokyo 2 figures are excluded.
scoped_project_details.efficiency_exclusion: PUE below 1.25 is a design target, not measured operating PUE. No carbon claim is translated into renewable electricity or annual energy use.
scoped_project_details.address_reconciliation: Operator factsheet page 2 gives 2-2-5 Kaguro-Minami. The May 24, 2024 CASBEE certificate independently identifies the Stage 7 data center property as Kaguro-Minami 2-chome 2-5, 2-8 and 2-9. This is historical property identity context, not a surveyed parcel union or achieved completion date.
